mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM agent_memory_index_outbox e WHERE ((e.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND e.next_retry_at<=NOW()) OR (e.status='PROCESSING' AND e.updated_at<DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_memory_index_outbox earlier WHERE earlier.agent_id=e.agent_id AND earlier.memory_id=e.memory_id AND earlier.id<e.id AND earlier.status NOT IN ('DONE','FAILED')) ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_memory_index_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND next_retry_at<=NOW()) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND updated_at<DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)))
UPDATE agent_memory_index_outbox SET status='DONE',last_error='',updated_at=NOW() WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE agent_memory_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{error},next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt},updated_at=NOW() WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE agent_memory_index_outbox SET status='FAILED',attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{error},updated_at=NOW() WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='PROCESSING'
